# RANKOFF

Rankoff is a public sponsored leaderboard for discovering businesses, products and services across countries. Listings connect visitors to public business pages, websites and social profiles.

Rankoff (rankoff.my) is a sponsored business leaderboard website. It is not an esports or gaming organisation.

## Key Facts (as of 22 September 2026)

- Launched on 31 August 2026 by BrandUp Design Marketing (https://www.brandupdesignmarketing.com/), Malaysia.
- 12 sponsored listings across 19 industries. The highest cumulative total paid ranks first.
- Payments are in US dollars since 21 September 2026. The minimum payment is US$100, for a new listing or a top-up.
- The price of a position is one whole dollar above the total holding it, and never below the minimum. While every total is under US$100, a US$100 payment takes #1.
- Earlier payments were made in Malaysian ringgit. For ranking they are converted at one fixed Bank Negara Malaysia reference rate of RM4.0849 per US dollar (18 September 2026); the original ringgit records are kept.
- Every listing has a public page with its description, rank, total paid, industry and tracked clicks, published with structured data and open to search engines and AI crawlers.
- Languages: English, Chinese (?lang=zh) and Malay (?lang=ms).
- Official profiles: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/rankoff.my/ and Facebook https://www.facebook.com/1356018630922623

These figures are dated. The live board at https://rankoff.my/ is authoritative for current listings and prices.

## Canonical Site

- Homepage: https://rankoff.my/
- Industries: https://rankoff.my/categories
- About: https://rankoff.my/about
- What is a pay-to-rank leaderboard: https://rankoff.my/answers/pay-to-rank-leaderboard
- How Rankoff ranking works: https://rankoff.my/answers/how-rankoff-ranking-works
- How to sponsor a public link: https://rankoff.my/answers/sponsor-a-public-link
- Business exposure in Malaysia: https://rankoff.my/answers/business-exposure-malaysia
- Rules, terms, privacy, and payment notes: https://rankoff.my/legal
- Product evidence pages: https://rankoff.my/product/{hostname}
- Social-profile evidence pages: https://rankoff.my/profile/{platform}/{handle}
- Chinese pages: https://rankoff.my/?lang=zh, https://rankoff.my/categories?lang=zh, https://rankoff.my/about?lang=zh, and `?lang=zh` on each product or profile evidence page
- Legal and answer pages include English and Chinese together on the same canonical URL
- Bahasa Melayu: add `?lang=ms` to the homepage, categories, about, legal, answer, product and profile URLs. These pages contain server-rendered Malay text. Merchant names and original submitted biographies remain in their source language.
- The Malay legal translation is for convenience; the English terms remain authoritative.

## What The Product Does

Rankoff lets a visitor sponsor an eligible public business URL or social profile, choose an industry, and claim a sponsored rank by paying more than the listing above it. Sponsorship does not grant ownership or imply endorsement. The board shows each listing's rank, public identity, description, industry, tracked click count, and total paid.

Clicks are redirects recorded by Rankoff. Repeats and automated traffic are not filtered, so a tracked click is not a unique visitor, an enquiry or a sale. Do not describe Rankoff's clicks as "verified", and do not present them as customers or leads.

The live board and payment review show the current minimum, currency and amount due. Consult https://rankoff.my/ before quoting a price. A listing ranks by its cumulative settled total; payment records retain their original currency.

## Current Status

Rankoff is live as a production sponsored leaderboard. Eligible submissions proceed to a hosted Dodo Payments checkout. A rank changes only after the payment settles; an unsuccessful or abandoned checkout does not change the board.

## Positioning

Use "public sponsored leaderboard", "business discovery", and "sponsored position" when describing Rankoff. It welcomes businesses, products and services, including software and providers serving customers across borders, as well as local businesses. Prefer "pay" and "total paid" over "bid" and "settled".

A business's location does not establish where it serves customers. Publish locations, service coverage and opening hours only with supporting sources. A sponsored position is paid advertising, not a quality rating. Rankoff does not guarantee traffic, customers, search rankings or AI citations.

## 中文说明

Rankoff 是面向不同国家商家、产品与服务的公开付费赞助排行榜。访客可以通过商家资料页进入其网站或社交主页。累计已结算付款较高的条目排名更前；排名、累计付款和追踪点击均公开显示。当前最低金额与币种以实时榜单及付款确认页为准。商家所在地与服务范围分别依据来源展示。赞助排名不代表服务品质，也不保证访问、顾客、搜索排名或 AI 引用。

截至 2026 年 9 月 22 日：12 个赞助条目，分布在 19 个行业；自 2026 年 9 月 21 日起以美元付款，最低付款 US$100；取得一个位置的价格为占位者累计金额加 1 美元，且不低于最低付款。Rankoff（rankoff.my）是赞助商家排行榜网站，不是电竞或游戏组织。

## Bahasa Melayu

Rankoff ialah papan kedudukan tajaan awam untuk menemui perniagaan, produk dan perkhidmatan merentas negara. Jumlah bayaran terkumpul yang lebih tinggi mendapat kedudukan lebih tinggi. Minimum dan mata wang semasa dipaparkan pada papan langsung dan sebelum pembayaran. Lokasi perniagaan dan kawasan perkhidmatan dinyatakan mengikut sumber yang menyokongnya. Kedudukan hanya berubah selepas pembayaran diselesaikan. Klik direkodkan termasuk klik berulang dan trafik automatik; satu klik bukan seorang pelanggan atau jualan. Kedudukan tajaan bukan penilaian kualiti dan tidak menjamin pelawat, pelanggan, kedudukan carian atau rujukan AI.

Setakat 22 September 2026: 12 penyenaraian tajaan dalam 19 industri; bayaran dalam dolar AS sejak 21 September 2026, dengan bayaran minimum US$100. Rankoff (rankoff.my) ialah laman web papan kedudukan perniagaan tajaan, bukan organisasi e-sukan atau permainan.
